text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I've no doubt that I made every effort I could in preparation. I held nothing back during the race either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's that my light remains too faint…
choice_data_list: Let's figure out a way to win, together!
You just need to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Please do provide me with all the knowledge and wisdom you can.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall redouble my efforts, so please continue to advise me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …! …Yes, you're absolutely correct. Although I exhausted my strength, there was still quite a gap between me and the competition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should have trained more, but I do not wish to use my health as an excuse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall fully devote myself to winning the next race, so please continue to support my efforts.
